international.title: First Thing: Trump administration blames travel chaos on former presidents and Congress
international.summary: Donald Trump on Sunday blamed the Biden administration for the four-hour nationwide flight stoppage that led to thousands of canceled flights over the weekend. Plus: How Israel is using Amazon facial recognition to track Palestinians Good morning. A four-hour nationwide flight stoppage on Friday threw the entire weekend into chaos, with thousands of flights getting canceled and even more delays. While air travel is expected to even out again on Monday, nearly 2,000 ​flights within, into or out of the US on Sunday were canceled and more than 8,600 were delayed. What’s the Trump administration saying? “I take responsibility for what was given to me by prior administrations,” the US transportation secretary, Sean Duffy, told CNN’s Dana Bash on Sunday. What has Trump said? Donald Trump did not comment on the ground stop until Sunday, when he posted on Truth Social blaming Joe Biden. “The Biden Administration was an FAA disaster. Everything they touched turned bad,” Trump wrote. “We have the knowledge and plan for the Flight Control Systems, we need Congress to give the money, FAST!” What caused the ground stop? Duffy on Saturday said the issue stemmed from routine maintenance . Who will he be meeting in China? China confirmed on Monday that Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin would hold their first trilateral summit on Thursday in Shenzhen. What’s at stake here? Trump is under pressure to speak with Xi about the Nvidia fallout, in which the company’s chief executive, Jensen Huang, was forced to resign amid revelations he had had an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.
